name: Stackcroft Guided Session Workspace
author: stackcroft

sections.description:
Stackcroft Guided Session Workspace lets site administrators manage clients, create linear text-based workflows, record sessions and produce basic summaries. The separately licensed Pro version adds advanced question formats, private front-end workspace, appointments, branding, client portal and automation.

Data is stored on the site owner’s WordPress hosting. The Freemius integration manages license and product-related operations. Booking, email and payment integrations require their own configuration. This software is not a medical device, diagnostic service, or substitute for professional advice.

Data privacy and external services

Client records, bookings, workflows and session notes are stored on the WordPress installation and handled by its administrator. The plugin offers an administrator-controlled export of known records. Configure access permissions, retention, privacy policy, backup and email delivery before storing real client data.

Freemius is bundled for optional product account, licensing, updates, purchase and trial management. Freemius may communicate installation and account information when the user opts in or activates licensing. Freemius publishes its Privacy Policy and Terms of Service from its official website: https://freemius.com/.

Optional WooCommerce checkout uses the site’s WooCommerce installation and configured payment gateway, which may transfer booking/payment information to those services. Online checkout is disabled by default and can be enabled under Availability & Payments once WooCommerce and the gateway are configured. Configure taxes, refund policies and payment notifications in WooCommerce. Pending payment orders are scheduled to be cancelled after 45 minutes using WP-Cron; operators should monitor failed or abandoned payments and confirm that reserved times become available again.

Outgoing emails rely on the site’s WordPress mail configuration and optional SMTP plugin. No external SMTP provider is configured by Stackcroft Guided Session Workspace itself. Public access to client reports requires explicit practitioner sharing controls. Do not use as a medical device or for emergency care.
sections.installation:
1. Install the free package in WordPress and activate it.
  2. Open Session Workspace in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Optional: upgrade to Pro via Freemius, activate a license or start an eligible trial.
  4. Configure your mail delivery, availability, and privacy controls before accepting real clients.
sections.faq:
Does Free require a subscription?

No. Free includes text-based linear workflows, session notes, clients and basic summaries.

Can administrators export their data after a Pro license expires?

Yes. The Data Export screen in the core plugin exports known GSW records as JSON even if Pro is unavailable. Treat the archive as confidential.

Can I use this to diagnose medical conditions?

No. It is general workflow and documentation software.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Normalized the plugin display name for Freemius-generated Free and Premium editions.
  • Preserved the existing plugin slug, paid feature separation and plugin settings.

1.0.3

  • Fixed admin-post form action names to match the uniquely prefixed save handlers.
  • WordPress.org review adjustments: uniquely prefixed global identifiers and hooks, and updated Freemius information link.

  • Removed the recurring Pro showcase admin notice; the showcase remains accessible from its menu.

  • Fixed the WordPress Plugin Check WordPress.DB.PreparedSQL.NotPrepared report for admin list queries by preparing SQL directly at the query call site.

  • Kept the existing table-identifier placeholders and allowlisted sorting; no change to session data, booking, WooCommerce, or licensing.

1.0.2

  • Hardened custom-table SQL reads and JSON archive queries using WordPress identifier placeholders.
  • Moved nonce verification into every administrator write handler before reading POST fields.
  • Sanitized nested workflow step and session answer inputs before processing.
  • Improved privacy exporter and eraser handling of invalid email addresses.
  • No changes to booking, payment, licensing or stored data schemas.

1.0.1

  • Updated WooCommerce checkout labels and setup guidance to reflect the standard integration.
  • Preserved the existing WooCommerce order, cancellation and booking synchronization logic.
  • Kept WooCommerce payments optional and disabled by default until configured by the site owner.

1.0.0

  • First commercial package for Freemius with working Free/Pro distribution.
  • Preserved onboarding, workflow, booking, communication, reports and client records.
  • Added a conservative pending WooCommerce order expiration check to reduce abandoned holds; dependent on WP-Cron and not a replacement for end-to-end payment testing.
  • Documented optional external services, offline-first configuration and payment limitations.
  • Moved release metadata to stable 1.0.0.

1.0.0-rc3

  • Commercial copy cleanup: removed development-only labels and outdated trial messaging.
  • Stopped automatic creation of a sample paid booking service.
  • Added a secure, admin-only JSON data archive available without a Pro license.
  • Prevented raw booking/portal shortcodes from appearing after Pro entitlement expires.
  • Updated the privacy policy guidance and mail-delivery descriptions.
  • Updated SDK-linked version metadata and maintained separate Free/Pro code paths.
